# Rapfi Runtime Directory

This directory contains the official Rapfi 2025-06-15 Windows engine package.
`Rapfi.exe` is an AVX2 copy of `pbrain-rapfi-windows-avx2.exe`, selected as the
default for this computer.

The package includes:

- `Rapfi.exe` and the original CPU-specific binaries
- The matching configuration and evaluation weights
- `COPYING.txt`, the GPLv3 license

Select the SSE binary from the app if this directory is copied to a computer
without AVX2 support.
